justification: Image A depicts a monumental, minimally-featured anthropomorphic head-and-torso figure with abstracted facial features, while image B depicts a flat inscribed panel densely covered in rows of small hieroglyphic-style signs and two seated figures at the bottom in registers. There is no overlap in the kinds of elements depicted (a single large sculpted figure vs. a text-covered stele with rows of small glyphs), no shared relationships between elements, and no shared arrangement or stylistic convention beyond both being carved stone surfaces, which is excluded from comparison.
